mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT res.resource_code FROM user_role sur INNER JOIN role r ON sur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN resource_role rr ON r.id = rr.role_id INNER JOIN resource res ON rr.resource_id = res.id AND res.status = 1 AND res.deleted = 0 WHERE sur.user_id = #{userId}

select r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_type, r.data_scope from universe_life_user.user_role ur inner join universe_life_user.role r on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0;

select r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_type, ur.granted_by, ur.created_at from universe_life_user.user_role ur inner join universe_life_user.role r on ur.role_id = r.id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0;
select r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name from universe_life_user.role r inner join universe_life_user.user_role ur on r.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 1 and r.deleted = 0;

SELECT r.id, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, ur.created_at AS assignedAt, su.username AS assignedBy FROM user_role ur INNER JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ur.granted_by = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ur.created_at DESC
